accounting.no_pooled_returns: per-venue aggregates only; no cross-venue pooled equity curve (no capital-allocation/conversion policy exists)
accounting.open_at_end: positions still open at the last candle retain exposure; valued at the last closed M15 close (valid mark); contribution reported separately, never blended into realized P&L
accounting.quantities: Decimal; partial exits preserved per fill

cost_sensitivity.note: frozen before performance numbers; not a parameter search

disaster_stop.basis: DOCUMENTED boundary (decisions doc: unresolved; task: none added)
disaster_stop.rule: none added; advisory reference stop is an R/sizing reference only

entry.label: candle-price proxy, not a guaranteed obtainable fill

excluded: one-hour time-exit policy from BTC M15/M5 research (not carried over)

HYPERLIQUID.source_updated: page states last updated about 1 month ago at fetch time

fees.fee_formula: fee = qty * price * rate; maker rate on TP fills, taker elsewhere

gap_fills.rule: entry and stop exits fill at the candle open regardless of gap; TP fills at the TP level price only when the candle high reaches it

max_holding.basis: GENUINELY_UNRESOLVED: the signal-mode resolver never forwards strategy_params (app/signal/strategy_config.py as_legacy_dict returns {}), so the older-strategy max_holding default cannot be established for Core V2.1 from config

protocol.name: core-v2.1-reference-backtest-v1

overlap.rule: one open position per strategy+symbol; entry events arriving while a position is open are recorded as OVERLAP_SKIPPED; the signal state machine is unaffected (replay ledger unchanged)

same_bar_ordering.rule: on the entry candle TP checks start on the NEXT candle; if a candle both closes below EMA21 (stop) and reaches a TP level (high), the close-based stop wins and TP fills in that candle are ignored

signals.reproduction: replay is regenerated from the locked anchor and must be row-identical to the audited historical ledger before any trade is simulated

strategy_stop.exit_fill: remaining quantity at following M15 open * (1 - slippage_rate)
strategy_stop.trigger: fully closed M15 Close < current M15 EMA21 (strict; wicks ignored)

take_profits.activation: limit-fill proxy at TP price when candle high >= level
take_profits.allocation: one third of the original quantity at each TP; the final third fills the exact remainder so the three partial quantities sum to the original
take_profits.levels: original signal reference TP1/TP2/TP3 (1R/2R/3R of reference entry)
